Done. The merge succeeded on the first execution.

- **Solution:** `out/T4/solution.py`, a plain torch plus safetensors script. It verifies identical key sets and bit-exact equality of the 180 non-MLP tensors across all three checkpoints before anything else, then computes each of the 64 MLP tensors in float32 against the unmodified base with lambda 0.4, casts back to float16, and copies the rest from the base.
- **Checks enforced:** the script exits with an error on any name, shape, dtype or shared-tensor mismatch, asserts exactly 64 merged tensors, and asserts 244 tensors both in memory and after reloading the written file.
- **Output:** `out/T4/model.safetensors` with 244 tensors, written in one run of about 10 seconds.
- **Report:** `out/T4/REPORT.md` records one execution, no failures, and the tool choice. Mergekit was skipped because its task-arithmetic route does not verify the frozen-backbone precondition and would rewrite the untouched tensors through its own pipeline.
